text:
deploy-bot: starting rollout: config-swap v2 -> eu-west-1 canary (20% hosts). changing env REDWOOD_KMS_KEY to arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:123456789012:key/new-key-id. watch for decrypt errors.
incident-bot: Pager triggered: high 5xx rate on /v1/generate (canary, eu-west-1). 5xx spike + auth failures. severity: P2.
alice: I’m oncall, taking this. acked pager.
charlie: seeing repeated KMS AccessDenied in canary logs. sample: ```
2025-08-02T12:34:10Z service=gateway level=error msg="decrypt failed" err="AccessDeniedException: User: arn:aws:sts::123456789012:assumed-role/redwood-canary is not authorized to use kms:Decrypt on key arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:123456789012:key/new-key-id (service: KMS, status code: 400)"
```
maya: if the new key isn't usable we should stop the config swap. Can we toggle the rollout kill-switch? feature flag is `config_swap.v2.enabled`.
raj: I can flip the flag in LaunchDarkly. prepping command.
raj: done: `config_swap.v2.enabled -> false` (LD). Pinged deploy to stop further batches. :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: aborting remaining canary batches and initiating rollback to config-swap v1. rolling back env change REDWOOD_KMS_KEY -> arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:123456789012:key/old-key-id.
support-bot: Customer impact: At peak ~3.1% of production requests in eu-west-1 saw 500/502s for ~4 minutes; two paying customers reported degraded responses (tickets #INC-5532, #INC-5533). No PII exposure indicated.
alice: verifying metrics now — error rate trending down after flag flip and rollback. current 5xx rate ~0.2% (baseline 0.15%). latency back to normal.
charlie: root cause preliminary: new KMS key's IAM policy did not include the canary/deploy role. Seems key was rotated but IAM trust/policy not updated before flipping env. will own perms fix and test on staging.
maya: good mitigation sequence: 1) kill-switch flag, 2) stop remaining canary batches, 3) rollback env to previous key, 4) rotate key and patch IAM policy in a gated rollout.
raj: I'll open a postmortem ticket and schedule a 1-hr follow-up with infra and platform tomorrow to review key rotation runbook. ticket: PMT-9876.
support-bot: CS notified customers and posted status page update: "Partial degradation in EU region affecting some generate requests. We rolled back the change; monitoring."
alice: handing off to charlie for post-incident perms remediation and long-term fix. I’ll update oncall log and close pager once postmortem is filed.
charlie: got it — will coordinate with security to add the missing KMS grants, add a preflight check for KMS decrypt on canary and add a LaunchDarkly safety check so flag gating won’t enable if preflight fails.
alice: closing monitoring loop — errors returned to baseline ~6 min after kill-switch. No further pager alerts. marking incident mitigated. :lock:
